title.narrative: Progress Report - HBP Member Marketing & Horticulture Sector Exposure

description.narrative: The initiative pursues four specific, baseline-validated objectives, each individually tracked per SME and measured against a pre-intervention diagnostic: 1. Brand visibility — establish and strengthen member SMEs' digital presence and market recognition. 2. Partnership development — position profiled SMEs to attract new commercial and business partnerships. 3. Market entry — support SMEs seeking to expand into new domestic markets. 4. Export readiness — build the market-facing profile SMEs need to access export opportunities.

This activity was designed to give HBP member SMEs in horticulture a structured market channel: a networking and sales platform to meet new buyers, partners and investors and convert those connections into business. HBP holds a standing partnership with Channel One TV for an annual/biennial agrifair (typically run in June and November), and had anticipated using the June 2026 edition as this channel. When it became clear this would not take place, HBP sought an alternative route to the same objective rather than let the market-access opportunity lapse for its members.

title.narrative: Report on Pilot Commercial Farm at WASS

description.narrative: This activity was undertaken to strengthen HBP's long-term sustainability as a sector platform by establishing evidence-based proof of concept for small-scale horticulture as a viable commercial enterprise in Ghana. No existing, documented local model demonstrates the profitability of small-scale vegetable production in a way that can be replicated across the sector; HBP, with support from the Ghana Netherlands Business and Culture Council (GNBCC), established a pilot commercial demonstration farm to close this evidence gap directly.

title.narrative: Report on Horticulture Trade Fair undertaking in Partnership with Channel One TV

description.narrative: To provide HBP member SMEs with a structured platform to exhibit their products and services to a broad consumer and trade audience, generate commercial sales and business linkages, and increase the visibility of HBP and the horticulture sector through national media coverage in partnership with Channel One TV.

To provide HBP member SMEs with structured visibility and a platform to grow their commercial profiles through digital media, by documenting and sharing their business stories via social and online channels to connect with broader audiences, attract new customers, and generate commercial inquiries.
